copy.text: Subscription tracker: the six fields that catch renewals

scenes.why: The hook is the guide's own title: the question it answers, as a person would put it.

copy.text: Look at anything renewing in the next two weeks.
For each one, choose keep or planned to cancel.
Open anything marked still deciding and settle at least one.
Add any subscription you started this month, including trials.

scenes.why: The guide's own checklist, the first sentence of each item, ticked in as it is read.

caption.text: The month you could be debt-free, and the order your debts clear

scenes.why: The turn: the product the guide itself hands over to, named and shown on its real screen, captioned with its listing's line closest to what the guide teaches. Screen: "Debt" (What you owe and when it could be gone: totals, a payoff plan worked out from your own numbers, and the debt-free date.) chosen because it is the real screen closest to "The month you could be debt-free, and the order your debts clear Subscription tr"; focus on "Total balance, Minimum payments".
Ends on where to read the whole guide, with the product beneath it: the viewer leaves with the next step, not only a pitch.

reasoning.decision: YouTube Short, 1080×1920, 18–45s, hook by 1.2s, sound on
reasoning.because: Search-adjacent audience that will watch a slightly longer explanation if it starts strong. Loops by default.

reasoning.because: The listing's own audience lines; the director writes for them.

reasoning.decision: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index"
reasoning.because: Transitions follow the product's own identity motif, "index": an index of tabs, so scenes slide in like the next tab.
Camera "float": a gentle float that keeps a held frame alive without demanding attention.
Grounds light → light → ink → accent: a cool accent, so a darker ground is used for contrast at a turn.
Its shape was 0.74 similar to guide-what-to-do-when-a-parent-dies--youtube-short; a different film, not the same one re-coloured.
Sound-on placement: every transition, landing and reveal has a cue, and the bed ducks under the brand moment.
Each scene is held for the time its words take to read on YouTube Short (0.26s a word), inside 18–45s.
